summary.zh-CN: 补齐全新安装的工作区模板与零密钥引导，让 OpenCode Zen 免费试用真正从第一步就开箱可用。
summary.en-US: Completes fresh-install workspace templates and zero-key guidance so OpenCode Zen free trials work cleanly from the first step.

body.zh-CN: 全新安装会从 NPM 包的正确位置创建工作区模板，不再显示找不到模板目录的警告。
body.en-US: Fresh installations create workspace templates from the correct npm package location without a missing-template warning.

body.zh-CN: 初始化完成后会直接提示 OpenCode Zen 无需 API Key 即可聊天，不再要求先配置密钥。
body.en-US: Initialization now explains that OpenCode Zen can chat without an API key instead of asking for a key first.

title.zh-CN: 默认模型与已有配置保持不变
title.en-US: Default model and existing configuration stay unchanged

body.zh-CN: 默认仍为 OpenCode Zen Free Trial / big-pickle；已有配置和工作区不会被覆盖。
body.en-US: The default remains OpenCode Zen Free Trial / big-pickle, and existing configuration and workspaces are preserved.
